name: Gyaana Nanda Mayam
text:
ज्ञानानन्दमयं देवं निर्मलस्फटिकाकृतिम् ।
आधारं सर्वविद्यानां हयग्रीवमुपास्महे ॥
meaning: We contemplate Hayagriva, full of knowledge and bliss, clear like a crystal and a foundation of all learning.
purpose: A devotional verse to Hayagriva as a source of knowledge.
supports: Study; memory; intellectual clarity; confidence in learning.
